description: MSF model with GOR curve vs TBT, scaling limits, and pumping SEC

unit.name: Large-scale MSF plant (Gulf region, 24-stage)
unit.source: El-Dessouky & Ettouney (2002) Fundamentals of Salt Water Desalination Ch.5; Darwish & Alsairafi (2004)

TBT_ref.note: Reference top brine temperature (Gulf MSF: 90-120 degC)

T_scale_limit.note: Carbonate scale onset temperature (90 degC, El-Dessouky 2002)

k_scale.note: SEC penalty per degC above scale limit (1% per degC)

m_ratio.note: Recycle brine to distillate mass ratio
